title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: Hold: the cost section says Microsoft states there is no charge for migration, but the documentation does not publish a migration price. Replace that assurance with a statement that pricing is not yet published; the documented migration controls, prerequisites and preview restrictions are otherwise supported.

claims.quote: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Migration-specific licensing is not yet published, and the migration page lists no licence among its prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: "migrate" "Lifecycle Services" "license" "charge". Opened migration, unified admin overview, storage capacity and integration pages; none specifies a migration-specific licence. The migration prerequisites name no licence.

claims.claim: The Learn migration page states there is no charge for the migration.
claims.quote: Searched: "migrate" "Lifecycle Services" "license" "charge". Opened the cited migration page and its capacity and unified admin references. None states that migration is free; the migration page does not publish a price.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: "The Learn migration page lists no licence among its prerequisites and does not publish a migration price." Keep the following sentence treating the price and licence as not yet published.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[2]
claims.claim: The finance and operations environment must be linked to a Power Platform environment before migration.
claims.quote: Link the environment to a Power Platform environment.

claims.claim: Dual-write need not be enabled to migrate an environment.
claims.quote: You don't have to enable dual-write to migrate an environment.

claims.claim: The migration page does not name a required Lifecycle Services project role.
claims.quote: Searched: "migrate" "Lifecycle Services" "project" "role" administrator. Read the migration page in full, including prerequisites, migration steps and failed-check resolutions; it names a linked Power Platform administrator, not an LCS project role.

claims.claim: The migration action is at Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center.
claims.quote: In the **Environments** section, find the sandbox that you want to migrate, and then select **Full details**.

claims.claim: No API for starting this Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center migration is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Lifecycle Services migration Power Platform API PowerShell pac admin; Lifecycle Services migration Power Platform API start. Read migration page and searched pac admin reference for migration/Lifecycle; results document UI, not a start API for this operation.

claims.claim: The Finance and Operations capacity report is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Capacity add-ons > Finance and Operations.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select **Licensing**.
3. In the **Licensing** pane, select **Capacity add-ons**.
4. Select **Finance and Operations**.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for the finance and operations storage capacity report is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations storage capacity report API PowerShell pac admin; finance operations tenantCapacity storage API. Read capacity page and daily capacity report tutorial; searched pac admin. Generic Dataverse capacity automation did not document this F&O report.

claims.where: controls[1].scope and controls[1].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The finance and operations report compares storage usage with licence entitlement and covers the tenant's environments.
claims.quote: Storage reporting covers usage at the tenant and environment level. All environments in all Lifecycle Services projects on the tenant are included in storage reporting.

claims.claim: The linked-environment prerequisite check is under Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Power Platform environment is linked.
claims.quote: On the environment details page, expand **Power Platform migration (Preview)**.

claims.claim: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails is the documented Dataverse call for checking integration status.
claims.quote: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails

claims.claim: When integrated, the Dataverse call returns Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the linked finance and operations environment.
claims.quote: If the Power Platform environment is linked to a finance and operations apps environment through the Power Platform integration, the API returns the Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the finance and operations apps environment.

claims.claim: The Dataverse call verifies integration status rather than starting migration.
claims.quote: The `RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails` API is available in Dataverse to validate the status of the Power Platform integration for the Power Platform environment.

claims.claim: The cited integration page does not specify which role may call RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails.
claims.quote: Searched: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails permissions role. Read Enable Power Platform integration in full, including the runtime status API request, response and error; no caller role is specified.

claims.claim: The migration section presents four green-check prerequisites for Deployed status, linkage, database capacity and linked-environment administrator status.
claims.quote:
**Environment is in Deployed status**.
    - **Power Platform environment is linked**.
    - **Database storage capacity is available**.
    - **You are an administrator of the linked Power Platform environment**.

claims.claim: The documented completion indicator is Migration status showing Migrated.
claims.quote: Wait until **Migration status** is **Migrated**, and then select **Open in Power Platform Admin Center**.

claims.claim: No new data location is documented for this control-plane migration.
claims.quote: Searched: migrate-lifecycle-services-environments-power-platform-admin-center data region. Read migration page and unified admin overview; the migration page says the database is not moved and infrastructure is not materially changed, with no new data location specified.
